# Bluetooth pairing reliability

This patch release makes first-time setup reliable on current Omarchy systems
and keeps the pairing path visible from beginning to end.

## Changes

- avoid a BlueZ 5.87 crash triggered by UUID-filtered Bluetooth discovery
- automatically resume discovery when BlueZ ends a scan before a watch is found
- keep the Omarchy Watch icon available while searching, with a **Scan Again** action
- open the pairing panel automatically when a new watch appears
- close the keyboard-focused panel reliably with Escape
- keep the six-digit pairing code awake on the watch until setup advances
- make immediate uninstall and reinstall cycles resilient to shell restart timing
- clarify that secure pairing must be started from the Omarchy Watch panel

## Install or update

Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch#install).
The attached flash bundle supports Espressif esptool 4.x and 5.x. It writes the
three firmware regions separately, so upgrading from v0.5.0 preserves pairing,
watch settings, and the cached profile.

This is an independent community project for development hardware, not an
official Omarchy product or a waterproof consumer watch.
